title.en: An Act to Amend Section One of Act Numbered Twenty-Nine Hundred and Sixteen, Exempting Certain Bonds of the Manila Railroad Company of the Philippine Islands From Taxation.

text.en:
Section one of Act Numbered Twenty-nine hundred and sixteen is hereby amended to read as
"Section 1. Any bonds heretofore and hereafter issued by the Manila Railroad Company of the Philippine
Islands and its predecessors, and all income directly derived therefrom shall be exempt from the payment of
any tax of the Government of the Philippine Islands or any division or political subdivision of the same."

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, November 24, 1934.
